fact: Since 3 August 2026 Congolese taxpayers can pay taxes, levies and customs duties online through the Fouta national switch after filing on the E-Tax or Sydonia platforms, with an electronic Treasury receipt issued, according to L'Economie.
The Fouta pilot with firms already used to e-filing is complete and rollout is progressive, to large then medium companies and to all taxpayers by the end of 2026, according to L'Economie.

Arrete no. 1009 of 22 May 2026 makes payment of public revenue exclusively electronic through the FOUTA platform, described as a national switch for tax and customs collection, with a 60-day compliance period.
The arrete says FOUTA applies to all public revenue including taxes, duties and fees, and is the single payment channel for tax and customs levies credited to the Treasury account at the BEAC.
